row.title: READ-BUDGET-10: repeated whole-window scans kept the tick lean after the indexes
row.body: Evidence: after the 0034 indexes the org D1 read about 182k rows an hour against the 120k cap (D1 query analytics, 2026-11-26 13:27 UTC). The ROI verdict re-aggregated seven days of free_tier_samples per resource on every read (102k rows an hour; /api/roi is public) and the criticality window counted its outcomes about nine times a tick (89k rows an hour). An index leaves an aggregate as long as it was; a cache shortens it. Decision: roi_cache (15 minutes) and criticality_cur_outcomes (half hour, keyed by the thresholds) are single org rows, and the cap stays where it is.
